SELECT CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM  app.BancaFisierTransfer
        WHERE CodSucursala = '[GetOrSession:BranchV]' 
          AND Anul = '[GetOrSession:YearV]'
          AND Luna = '[GetOrSession:MonthV]' 
          AND Status = 8
    ) THEN 2 
    ELSE 1   
END AS TokenStatusBanci;
